name: Social-authority influencer surge (authority sentiment leads crowd)
rationale: A shift in HIGH-AUTHORITY social sentiment (vetted influencer / insider accounts, not raw crowd volume) can precede a move before the broad crowd and price catch up — an attention/positioning lead. Ride crypto momentum only while authority sentiment is above a fitted floor; exit when authority sentiment rolls over. Disconfirmer: exit when twitter_influencer_sentiment crosses back down through the exit level. NOTE: DATA-BLOCKED — the authority-sentiment feeds are KEY-GATED (twitter_influencer_sentiment needs XAI_API_KEY; the LunarCrush social metrics need LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY) and currently return 0 rows, and the keyless proxies (reddit_sentiment, osint_air_activity) are snapshot-thin (0-4 rows). So this spec CANNOT be gated yet — it is queued behind either a paid key or a continuous keyless-proxy backfill. The deterministic Gate (deflated Sharpe / PBO / holdout / FDR) judges it only once a real point-in-time history exists; this is a low-confidence tier1 hypothesis that must earn its place OOS, never the money path until it passes.
catalyst: rising high-authority social sentiment while crypto momentum is positive
